recipe: Create a tuplify helper function to automatically type tuple returns when writing multiple custom hooks.
trigger_condition: You write a lot of custom hooks that return arrays of mixed types.
evidence: A helper function that automatically types tuples can also be helpful if you write a lot of custom hooks:

recipe: Return proper objects instead of tuples when your custom hook needs to return more than two values.
trigger_condition: Your custom hook returns more than two values.
evidence: Note that the React team recommends that custom hooks that return more than two values should use proper objects instead of tuples, however.

recipe: Expose your type definitions when publishing a React Hooks library so consumers can use them.
trigger_condition: You are writing a React Hooks library for others to consume.
evidence: If you are writing a React Hooks library, don't forget that you should also expose your types for users to use.
